name: mesa-rpg
description: RPG de mesa tático com acesso web — Host no PC do Mestre, jogadores no navegador/celular

scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client-host && npm run build -w client-web
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -k -n shared,server,host,web -c gray,green,magenta,cyan "npm run watch -w shared" "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client-host" "npm run dev -w client-web"
scripts.migrate: npm run build:shared && npm run migrate -w server
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm test -w shared && npm test -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client-common && npm run typecheck -w client-host && npm run typecheck -w client-web
